top_signals.title: Jensen Huang says he is open to Nvidia return
top_signals.summary: Jensen Huang has said he would be willing to return as Nvidia chief executive if asked by the board, breaking his silence five days after resigning amid allegations of extramarital affairs and links to a suspected Chinese intelligence operative. The billionaire co-founder said he had been overwhelmed by calls from employees, investors and tech executives [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
